name: infisical
blocker: The only Playwright suite (e2e/, 3 specs) is a black-box smoke suite against the deployed https://gamma.infisical.com (hardcoded in e2e/helpers/constants.ts), behind Twingate, needing real E2E_SCIM_TOKEN / E2E_IDP_ADMIN_TOKEN secrets and an external mock-IdP Cloudflare Worker; it never starts a local app.
authSetup: SCIM provisioning + SAML against the remote IdP, per test
notes: backend/e2e-test/ is an in-process Vitest suite, not Playwright. No local-app Playwright suite exists.
